title: 24 GB graphics cards
evidence: Not certified (L2x, RTX 5090 under a 22 GB cap): Qwen3.5 9B as QLoRA at 32K loaded and trained (95% of the card busy) but every run was ended before its result: on Windows each byte a run holds on the card is also charged to the computer's commit (RAM + page file), and the shared computer it ran on had 19-33 GB of commit free. Measure again on a computer with nothing else running or a larger page file.
